newsitem.title: BELGIUM: ELEVEN BLN BFR THEME PARK TO BE BUILT IN BELGIUM.
newsitem.headline: ELEVEN BLN BFR THEME PARK TO BE BUILT IN BELGIUM.

text.p: The southern Belgian region of Wallonia will announce on Thursday a 11 billion Belgian franc project to build a theme park near the south-eastern city of Verviers, not far from the border with Germany.

Walloon government sources said on Wednesday the region would contribute two billion francs towards the cost of the park which will have 25 major attractions. The project will employ 1,000 people and the park will open in five years' time.
Further details, including the name of the operator, were to be announced at a news conference on Thursday.
